source_notes.label: Crystallites, particles and sintered grains
source_notes.summary: XRD coherence length, TEM particle diameter and350 nm sintered grains have different bases; none are averaged or recast as the same size variable.

source_notes.label: Unresolved CeIII oxidation mechanism
source_notes.summary: The source proposes hydrolysis after local base generation, followed by oxidation; the oxidant/mechanism is explicitly unresolved. This is not a measured precursor structure.

claims.label: Main prose
claims.statement: The highest relative density at 1250 °C is described as 92% even after prolonged firing.
claims.locator: Main PDF p.4, isothermal sintering discussion

claims.label: Figure 7
claims.statement: The plotted 1250 °C curve approaches approximately 93% by 120 min (qualitative graph reading, not a tabulated exact result).

evidence_conflicts.disposition: Retain the prose value and original curve together. Do not silently substitute a digitized value or assign the prose maximum to an exact unstated firing duration.
